ei.title: How Three Product Versions Shape Consumer Choice
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: When I worked for a large electronics company that manufactured laser and ink-jet printers, I soon discovered why there are often three versions of many consumer goods. If the manufacturer makes only one version of its product, people who bought it might have been willing to spend more money, so the company is losing some income. If the company offers two versions, one with more features and more expensive than the other, people will compare the two models and still buy the less expensive one. But if the company introduces a third model with even more features and more expensive than the other two, sales of the second model go up; many people like the features of the most expensive model, but not the price. The middle item has more features than the least expensive one, and it is less expensive than the fanciest model. They buy the middle item, unaware that they have been manipulated by the presence of the higher-priced item.

소비자는 더 비싼 품목의 존재에 조종당해 중간 제품을 산다.

questions.passage: ①If the company offers two versions, one with more features and more expensive than the other, people will compare the two models and still buy the less expensive one. ②But if the company introduces a third model with even more features and more expensive than the other two, sales of the second model go down; many people like the features of the most expensive model, but not the price. ③The middle item has more features than the least expensive one, and it is less expensive than the fanciest model. ④They buy the middle item, unaware that they have been manipulated by the presence of the higher-priced item.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 원문과 다르게 바뀐 부분을 포함하는 것은?

det.korean: ② go down → go up: 원문은 두 번째 모델의 판매량이 '오른다(go up)'
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문 일치: 두 버전일 때 더 싼 것을 산다는 내용
✅ ② go down → go up: 원문은 'sales of the second model go up'(판매량이 오른다)이나 'go down'(내려간다)으로 바뀌어 의미가 반대 ←정답
❌ ③ 원문 일치: 중간 품목은 가장 싼 것보다 기능이 많고 가장 고급보다 싸다는 내용
❌ ④ 원문 일치: 더 비싼 품목의 존재에 조종당한다는 내용
det.tip: sales of the second model go up = 두 번째 모델 판매량이 오른다 (down 아님)

questions.passage: When I worked for a large electronics company that manufactured laser and ink-jet printers, I soon discovered why there are often three versions of many consumer goods. If the manufacturer makes only one version of its product, people who bought it might have been willing to spend more money, so the company is losing some income. If the company offers two versions, one with more features and more expensive than the other, people will compare the two models and still buy the less expensive one. But if the company introduces a third model with even more features and more expensive than the other two, sales of the second model go up; many people like the features of the most expensive model, but not the price. The middle item has more features than the least expensive one, and it is less expensive than the fanciest model. They buy the middle item, unaware that they have been manipulated by the presence of the higher-priced item.
questions.stem: 본문에 따르면, 회사가 제품을 한 가지 버전만 만들면 잃게 되는 것은 무엇인가? 본문에서 찾아 영어 2단어로 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: some income(수입의 일부): 한 가지 버전만 만들 때 회사가 잃는 것
det.analysis: 본문 S2 'so the company is losing some income' — 제품을 한 가지 버전만 만들면 회사는 'some income'(수입의 일부)을 잃는다.
det.tip: losing some income = 수입의 일부를 잃는 중
